task: Escribe 4 o 5 frases sobre ti: nombre, edad, de dónde eres, dónde vives y qué te gusta.
paragraphs: Hello! My name is Lucía and I'm twenty-three years old. I'm from Rosario, in Argentina, but now I live in London.
I'm a student. I study English and Design at a college near my flat. My flat is small, but it's nice. I live with two friends, Tom and Aisha. Tom is from Ireland and Aisha is from India.
I like music and coffee. I don't like rainy days, and London has a lot of rainy days! My favourite place in London is a big park near my college. On Saturdays, I go there with my friends.
My English is not perfect, but it's better every day.
